candidats.description: A building of the Pázmány Péter Catholic University Faculty of Law and Political Sciences. Built to HQ of the Szent István Társulat (~~Stephen I of Hungary Association), R.C. publishing house in Romantic style with Neo-Gothic elements in 1897-98. Architect: Antal Hofhauser. Till 1945 Stephaneum Printing, till 1980s/1990s Franklin Printing. The University moved in after/around 1996. Above the the geteways 2-2 sitting bear stone statues holding 1-1 shield. In middle of the facade is a King Saint Stephen stone statue, in his left hand he holds a double cross while his right is extended blessedly.
